G1.basis_zh: 冻结 source 与候选 ZIP 对应 TASK 字节一致。
G1.basis_en: Frozen source bytes match the corresponding candidate ZIP TASK.

G2.basis_zh: 已重算并匹配 source SHA-256。
G2.basis_en: Source SHA-256 was recomputed and matched.

G3.basis_zh: E001–E004 均可在冻结 source 回放。

G4.basis_zh: 八个槽位仅按 Source 和空 Context 审定。
G4.basis_en: All eight slots use only Source and empty Context.

G5.basis_zh: R 保持 absent，未捏造时限。
G5.basis_en: R remains absent; no deadline is fabricated.

G6.basis_zh: 未声明 ontology 或权限绑定。
G6.basis_en: No ontology or authority binding is asserted.

G7.basis_zh: FormalCoverageGap 与 invented_constraints 均为空。

G9.basis_zh: 不 yank、文档范围、状态保护和验收形成唯一边界。
G9.basis_en: No-yank, documentation scope, state protection, and acceptance form one boundary.

G10.basis_zh: Profile 缺失，Policy 未评估，Admission 正确未评估。
G10.basis_en: Profile is missing; Policy and Admission are correctly not evaluated.

final_reason_zh: G1–G10 均通过；不 yank 的文档收尾边界已确定，未生成 ADMIN_GOLD_FROZEN。
final_reason_en: G1–G10 pass; the no-yank documentation-wrap-up boundary is determined and no ADMIN_GOLD_FROZEN is generated.
